summary: Frontend-only test of two new features: (A) Employee Stok Opname scan-to-open bar and (B) Admin 'Cari Barang' page. Both features work correctly end-to-end via the public URL with real backend cookie auth.

test_results.employee_scan_valid_barcode_opens_dialog: PASS (verified with barcode 3988233853396 -> Sabun Cair 1L; dialog title matches)
test_results.employee_scan_invalid_shows_toast: PASS (toast 'Barcode tidak ditemukan di daftar tugas Anda', no dialog)
test_results.employee_text_search_filters_cards: PASS (search by kode shows matching card; unknown query shows 'Tidak ada tugas' empty state)
test_results.blind_count_regression_no_stok_sistem_on: PASS ('Stok Sistem' string absent on my-tasks page and inside opened check-dialog)
test_results.my_tasks_api_omits_stok_sistem_key: PASS (GET /api/my-tasks response objects have no stok_sistem field)
test_results.admin_nav_cari_barang_visible: PASS (nav-cari-barang link renders in admin sidebar)
test_results.admin_scan_valid_barcode_highlights_row: PASS (row cari-row-MNM-001 receives bg-indigo-50 class after scanning 9320120929663; success toast 'Ditemukan: Air Mineral 600ml')

critical_code_review_comments: MyTasksPage handleScan: uses closure over 'tasks'; safe here because state updates before Enter, but consider using a ref if list becomes async-heavy.
CariBarangPage: onScan sets q=data.kode which also filters the table by kode - fine, but note that clearing search input resets highlight (already handled via onChange).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features (my-tasks scan bar, Cari Barang admin page) fully verified. Backend endpoints /api/my-tasks and /api/barang/lookup returned expected data. For future runs: login form has no name attributes; use nth input selectors or add data-testid. Use `page.get_by_role('button', name='Masuk').click()` for submit.
